fato_historico: 1978: During the Rhodesian Bush War a group of ZIPRA guerrillas shot down civilian Vickers Viscount aircraft (Air Rhodesia Flight 825) with a Soviet-made SAM Strela-2; of 56 passengers and crew 38 people died in crash, 10 were massacred by the guerrillas at the site.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a profound invitation to mend what has been broken in your spirit. Like a calm breeze following a tempest, it is a good time to release heavy memories of past turbulence. Consider shifting your focus toward the gentle light of peace, nurturing your heart with compassion and seeking grace in every interaction.
frase_do_dia: Peace is a quiet garden where the soul finds space to bloom anew.
significado_numero: Represents the path of inner reflection and the shedding of old illusions.
conselho: Choose forgiveness today to free your heart from the shadows of yesterday.
